name: iCloud Mail drafts
description: Saves email drafts to your iCloud Drafts folder over IMAP, for you to review and send from Mail on any of your devices, and replaces a draft with a new version. It never sends anything. Valet signs in with your app-specific password; the tool code never sees it, and can reach only the Drafts and Deleted Messages folders.

mail.description: Your iCloud email address and an app-specific password (account.apple.com, Sign-In and Security, App-Specific Passwords)

tools.name: create_draft
tools.title: Save a draft
tools.description: Saves a new plain-text draft in iCloud Drafts. Nothing is sent: the person reviews and sends it from Mail. For a reply, pass the original's messageId as inReplyTo and its references, from mail_read, and a subject starting Re:.

tools.name: replace_draft
tools.title: Replace a draft
tools.description: Saves a new version of a draft and moves the old one, found by its messageId, to Deleted Messages. Pass every field again: nothing carries over from the old version.
